_comment: Titles for the SRD documents whose own first heading is a section rather than a title, keyed by file name. The file names are one lowercase run - msrdequipmentweaponsandarmor - so they cannot be split back into words, and the document has to be read to name it. Each entry needs a 'why' so the next reader can tell a fix from an opinion.

msrdadvancedclassesI.why: Opens on 'Qualifying for an Advanced Class', which is the first section of twelve.
msrdadvancedclassesI.title: Advanced Classes I

msrdadvancedclassesII.why: Titled 'CAMPAIGN ADVANCE CLASSES' in the document; named for its companion file.
msrdadvancedclassesII.title: Advanced Classes II

msrdbasicclasses.why: Opens on a table column called 'Ability'.
msrdbasicclasses.title: Basic Classes

msrdequipmentbasics.why: Opens on 'On-Hand Objects', the first of eight sections.
msrdequipmentbasics.title: Equipment Basics

msrdequipmentweaponsandarmor.why: Opens on 'Weapons', which is one of sixteen sections rather than the title.
msrdequipmentweaponsandarmor.title: Weapons and Armor

msrdpsionics.why: Opens on 'How to Read a Power Description'.
msrdpsionics.title: Psionics

msrdskillsi.why: Opens on 'Computer Hacking'; the companion file titles itself SKILLS II.
msrdskillsi.title: Skills I

msrdskillsii.why: Titled 'SKILLS II' in the document; matched to its companion.
msrdskillsii.title: Skills II

msrdskillsoverview.why: Opens on 'Getting Skills', the first of fifteen sections.
msrdskillsoverview.title: Skills Overview
